status: partial; statistical approximation, remaining and worsened rows explicit
unit: blocks per million 3D biome blocks; double plants count both halves
method: Fresh full generated chunks for all occurrences of ten target biomes in the two original main census windows; independent biome-conditioned statistics, never coordinate matches
limitations: The meadow provider is an original smooth three-field statistical approximation calibrated on both reference worlds, not a reconstruction of original parameters or an exact dual_noise implementation. Original phase and third-seed generalization remain unverified.
The meadow attempt mask selects one 8x8 quadrant per chunk; exact natural patch shape/streams remain unverified.
Cherry placement uses measured triangular attempts and replacement rules; original attempt count/streams and third-seed generalization remain unverified.
Leaf-litter masks and tree selection are unchanged; boundary and tree-population dependent rows remain explicit.
Exact original placement streams and cross-chunk incoming light for mushroom checks remain unverified.
Cave, tree and structure rows automatically classified as F are not assigned to this batch merely because of that label.

fixes.cause: An extra meadow wildflower multiplier doubled patches; grass density compensated for the missing soil restored by A3. Remove the multiplier and independently retain whole grass candidates without shifting flower intervals.

Rates tuned for incomplete soil became excessive after A3. Reduce whole patch centers and retain whole grass candidates. Exact original attempt counts remain unverified; the second-seed petal row remains outside tolerance.
Vegetation added a second brown giant-mushroom population on top of the tree pass. Retain only rare whole extra mushrooms; keep red candidates unchanged.
Ground mushroom candidates ignored light on ordinary soil. Check actual chunk light <=12; preserve podzol/mycelium exceptions. Incoming neighbor light remains unverified.

Biome clump frequencies were too high after selecting suitable shoreline. Adjust whole clump density; preserve stalk heights and individual placement stream. Exact original attempt counts remain unverified.

Habitat accepted plain terracotta but rejected colored terracotta; dry grasses additionally rejected dirt. Restore supported natural substrate types, exclude glazed terracotta, and adjust rates for the complete habitat.
Ground-cover profiles underpopulated measured suitable habitat. Adjust profile frequencies. Exact original attempt counts remain unverified.
Dense-forest patch multiplier was applied to sparse windswept forest. Lower whole patch share; exact original attempt counts remain unverified.

review_root_causes.discrepancy: meadow species, grass and patch composition
review_root_causes.cause: Independent weighted flower selection discarded coordinate-coherent, three-dimensional, world-seed-independent provider states. The tall/short grass states were absent; independent grass could overlap provider grass zones.
review_root_causes.change: Three smooth fields, fine selector, all eight ordered states; world seed only in patch attempts. Independent grass/tall retention and bounded patch occupancy.

review_root_causes.cause: Square dense patches and independent column treatment failed on slopes and tiny biome boundaries; petal attempts also rejected replaceable grass/litter.
review_root_causes.change: Five seeded centers per source chunk, triangular X/Z and +/-1 Y attempts, bounded biome/soil checks and verified grass/litter replacement.

review_root_causes.cause: Per-biome attempt profiles did not match eligible soil rates after A3.
review_root_causes.change: Swamp grass retained independently; Beach and Windswept Forest grass/tall rates measured on valid soil, no sand support added.
